mira (sre): Heads-up: we're running an edge-router BGP failover exercise in eu-west on 2026-06-10 03:00-03:45 UTC. Objective: validate automatic peering fallback, confirm traffic reroute to spare ASN, and measure cold-path p99 impact.
mira (sre): Expected visible effects: brief route convergence causing small burst of 429/504 for a minute, possible p95 elevation for up to 10m. No planned customer outage but plan for alert noise.
ci-bot: Maintenance window scheduled: bgp-failover-euwest (id: mw-7112) 2026-06-10T03:00:00Z -> 2026-06-10T03:45:00Z
ben (net): We'll flap primary peer for 30s then let automatic AS-path failover happen. I'll keep BGP debug logs on and capture MRT snapshots.
olga (infra): I'll set maintenance flag in Console for edge-router services and disable auto-deploys for the 2h window. Command: `redwood infra maintenance set --svc=edge-router --window=03:00-05:00`
sam (oncall): On-call here. Abort criteria? If we see sustained >=2% 5xx across global egress for 10m or route convergence >3m, abort and move to manual sinkholing.
mira (sre): Abort triggers documented in runbook: sustained global 5xx >=2% for 10m OR route convergence >180s. Manual sinkhole play lives in section 4. Runbook: https://redwood-internal.example/runbooks/edge-bgp-failover
lia (product): We'll pause scheduled customer demos hitting eu-west during the window. We'll notify any active partners via the partner channel.
ben (net): I'll also pre-warm spare ASN with prefix announcements to reduce path warmup time. Post-exercise I'll publish MRT + traceroute samples in the doc.
ci-bot: Preflight checks OK: MRT space allocated, canary traffic generator queued (job id: canary-bgp-7112)
mira (sre): Monitoring checklist: enable high sampling on routing service traces, add temporary suppression for known noisy BGP health alerts, watch global egress p99 and edge-router error budget.
sam (oncall): I'll be in channel 02:45-04:30 and will open an incident channel if abort conditions hit.
mira (sre): Postmortem sync set for 2026-06-10 11:00 UTC (30m). Drop MRTs/traces in the runbook doc. TL;DR: edge BGP failover exercise in eu-west 03:00-03:45 UTC, expect short routing blips, abort if sustained 5xx>=2% 10m or convergence>180s. Ping me for questions. :satellite:
